title: JumpScape level
description: A JumpScape level. See Levels/README.md. Coordinates are in a 1920x1080 world; y grows downwards and every position is an object's top-left corner.

description.description: Notes for whoever edits the level. The game ignores this.

startArea.description: Name of the area the player starts in. The first area if left out.

areas.description: The parts of the level. Most levels have one area; portals connect several.

number.description: A number, or groundY / groundLength with an optional +N or -N, like "groundY-150". groundY is the top of the ground (1017), groundLength is 2880.

color.description: A hex code like "#4A0D12" or a color name like "DarkRed" or "CornflowerBlue".

x.description: 0 is the left edge, 1920 the right edge.

y.description: 0 is the top of the first screen. Negative values are above it.

name.description: The area's name. Shown as a banner when the player arrives through a portal (except for "main").

sky.description: Background color. CornflowerBlue if left out.

tint.description: Color the platforms are tinted with. White (no change) if left out.

platforms.description: Grass platforms, 63 px thick. The first is usually the ground: { "x": -50, "y": "groundY", "length": "groundLength" }.

monster.description: Puts a frog on the platform.

crumbling.description: Breaks 3 s after the player lands on it, and comes back 5 s later.

doors.description: Exit doors (123x140 px). Going through one finishes the level.

locked.description: Needs a key. Each locked door uses up one key.

portals.description: Glowing doors that take the player to another portal, usually in another area.

name.description: This portal's name, so other portals can lead here.

leadsTo.description: Name of the portal this one leads to.

keys.description: Keys that unlock locked doors and portals.

ghosts.description: Ghosts that chase the player when they come close.

radius.description: How close (in pixels) the player must come before the ghost chases them.

powerUps.description: Power-ups (44x44 px) the player collects by touching them.

type.description: health gives back a heart; doubleJump and highJump last 15 s.

npcs.description: Friendly characters the player can talk to with E. Place them anywhere above a platform; they stand on the platform below.

lines.description: What the character says, one entry per line.
